summary.text: The Cabal is a black-aligned order of Dominaria, founded on Otaria by Virot Maglan, that ran pit fights and worshipped Kuberr before becoming a death cult under the demon Belzenlok.

bio.text: Virot Maglan founded the Cabal after the collapse of Suderbod, focused on commerce, and it grew in wealth and influence through its pit fights, especially after the Phyrexian Invasion.
In the Battle for the Mirari Chainer usurped the Cabal, and he lost control of the Mirari's power in a pit fight against Kamahl, after which Cabal City was abandoned.
Cabalists fought and allied with various forces, including Kamahl and the Order, and Braids killed the Patriarch with a nightmare beast while Phage and Braids took control of the Cabal.
After Karona's War the Cabal was left with no leader and no god and was presumed defunct around 4500 AR.
After the Mending a Cabal group's spell accidentally freed the demonlord Belzenlok, who restored the Cabal's power and moved its capital to the Stronghold in Urborg.
Under Belzenlok the Cabal spread across Dominaria as a death cult and routed the Church of Serra, until the Weatherlight crew under Jhoira defeated the Stronghold and killed Belzenlok.
After Belzenlok's death Lagomos maintained the Cabal until members summoned Braids to lead them, and later Cabal agents infiltrated New Argive.

status.text: The Cabal's last Dominarian story shows it crushed at the Stronghold and Belzenlok dead, with later material describing a resurgent group fought by the Benalish and an Echoverse Cabal at war with Benalia.
